# Cncf Alibaba Cloud Serverless App Engine Reviewer

Review Alibaba Cloud Serverless App Engine using its official documentation and repository in the Serverless / Hosted Platform category. Serverless Application Engine (SAE) is an application-oriented Serverless PaaS platform that helps PaaS users to go to the cloud without O&amp;M, pay-as-you-go, and low-threshold microservices. It combines Serverless architecture and microservice architecture perfectly.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
